shelfMain.empty.hint.android: Imported EPUB books will appear here. Tap "Import" above to choose files from your device.
shelfMain.empty.hint.desktop: Imported EPUB books will appear here. Click "Import" above or drag files directly into the window.
shelfMain.space.lock.tip: Lock the private shelf and return to the library
shelfMain.private.unlock.title: Private Shelf
shelfMain.private.unlock.hint: Enter the password. It locks again when the app closes.
shelfMain.private.setup.title: Set Up Private Shelf
shelfMain.private.setup.hint: Books, progress and notes here are kept apart: they never appear in the library, library search, archives, device transfer or cloud sync. The password stays on this device; book files are not encrypted.
shelfMain.private.setup.forgetNote: If you forget the password, the only way back is to clear the private shelf. Book files are not deleted.
shelfMain.private.reset.title: Clear Private Shelf?
shelfMain.private.reset.hint: Its book list, progress, bookmarks, notes and password are deleted and can't be restored. Book files stay, and the library is not affected.
shelfMain.private.reset.leftover: A previous clear didn't finish. Clear the old private shelf data before setting a new password. Book files stay.
shelfMain.move.in.title: Move to Private Shelf
shelfMain.move.in.hint: "{title}" moves to the private shelf with its progress, bookmarks, notes and favorite. The book file stays where it is. Enter the password to continue; the shelf locks again afterwards.
shelfMain.move.in.setupHint: "{title}" moves to the private shelf with its progress, bookmarks, notes and favorite. The book file stays where it is. Set a password for the private shelf first; it locks again afterwards.
shelfMain.move.out.title: Move out of Private Shelf?
shelfMain.move.out.hint: "{title}" returns to the library with its progress, bookmarks, notes and favorite, and takes part in sync, search and archives again. The book file stays where it is.
shelfMain.move.localNote: This only moves it on this device. Copies already synced to other devices or exported stay as they are.
shelfMain.move.pendingProgress: This book has reading progress to recover. Reopen it and save before moving it.
shelfMain.move.noHash: This book has no content fingerprint yet
shelfMain.move.unavailable: The shelf is busy. Try again in a moment.
shelfMain.search.quick.label: Quick search books
shelfMain.folder.name: "{name}"
shelfMain.sort.title: Sort: Title
shelfMain.empty.title: Your library is empty
shelfMain.favorites.hint: Click the star icon in the top left of a book card to add it to favorites
shelfMain.folder.emptyHint: Select multiple books or use the card menu to move books into this folder
shelfMain.search.noneHint: Try another keyword or clear filters
shelfMain.filter.noneHint: Clear the filters to see all your books again
shelfMain.table.title: Title
shelfMain.table.author: Author
shelfMain.table.time.tip: Click to sort by reading time
shelfMain.merge: Merge "{first}" and "{second}" into a new folder
shelfMain.delete.hint: Your original files will not be deleted (copies in the library are removed too). This book's reading progress, bookmarks, notes, favorite status and categories on this device will be cleared and cannot be recovered.
shelfMain.delete.hintOriginal: Only the shelf entry is removed; the original file stays where it is. This book's reading progress, bookmarks, notes, favorite status and categories on this device will be cleared and cannot be recovered.
shelfMain.drag.strip: Drop here to move into folder
shelfMain.dock.export.tip: Export selected books as new archive
shelfMain.dock.send.tip: Send to another device via Device Transfer
shelfMain.folder.levelFive.hint: This is the fifth level; subfolders cannot go deeper. Importing a folder tree here puts books from deeper directories directly in this level.
